name: Shake Shack Singapore Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by Shake Shack and documents a dine-in restaurant transaction at a Singapore location. The header contains the Shake Shack branding, location information, GST details, transaction date and time, and receipt reference. The order consists of five items, including a Shack Stack, Chick'n Shack, fries, large iced tea, and Shack Attack, with the individual prices shown alongside each selection. The financial section records a total of 43.80 inclusive of GST, with 7% GST of 2.86 identified within the transaction. Payment was made in cash, with 50.80 tendered and 7.00 returned as change. The lower portion contains a customer appreciation message, promotes Shake Shack Singapore's social-media presence, encourages customers to use the #shakeshacksg hashtag, and displays buzzer number 1124 together with staff and POS references associated with the order.
